💳 M-Pesa

⚡ Connect Real M-Pesa (Instant Payment)

Money always goes straight to your own M-Pesa — never through Doughty. Your Shortcode (Till/Paybill) and Passkey are required, from Safaricom's Go Live process for your business. Consumer Key/Secret are optional — leave them blank to use Doughty's shared connection, or enter your own if you have a personal Daraja app. Get these from Safaricom Daraja.
